journey.name: Support Store Gateway Availability Inspection
journey.description: Validates that support agents inspecting a merchant's detail page can view the payment gateways available to that store, including availability status, plain message, reason codes, next steps, store default gateway, and test mode notice.

story.title: Inspect merchant payment gateway catalogue and reasons

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard, navigate to '/dashboard/merchants', and select a merchant to view '/dashboard/merchants/{tenantId}'.
Scroll down to the 'Payment Gateways Availability' section.
Verify the section header contains the notice 'Platform credentials are checked in test mode.'
Verify each gateway displays its name, an 'Available' (green) or 'Unavailable' (rose) status badge, and an indicator if it is the store's default gateway.
Verify any unavailable gateway clearly surfaces its plain message, reason code (e.g. credentials_missing, circuit_open), and actionable next step with hint.
